candidate.bug_signature: duplicate non-repeatable just attributes with different arguments are accepted
candidate.runtime_class: offline Rust CLI build plus subprocess verifier
candidate.repro_summary: Create a justfile with repeated non-repeatable recipe attributes such as two confirm attributes with different string values, then invoke just in a mode that compiles the file.
candidate.bad_behavior: The parser keys attributes by full attribute value, so duplicate non-repeatable attributes with different arguments are accepted.
candidate.expected_behavior: All duplicate non-repeatable attributes are rejected even when their arguments differ; the diagnostic reports the attribute name and first/duplicate lines.
candidate.preserved_behavior: The group attribute remains repeatable, and valid mixes of different non-repeatable attributes continue to compile.
edge_cases: duplicates in one bracketed attribute list
duplicates separated by repeatable group attributes

test_surface.primary_api: just CLI invoked against temporary justfiles
offline_fixtures: temporary justfile directories created by pytest
test_surface.skip_guard_policy: No platform skips; tests avoid shell execution except --list/--summary compilation paths.
